# `features/comments`

People discuss a record in a thread, with a composer and attachments.

## Selection

- **Use when:** People discuss a record in a thread, with a composer and attachments.
- **Avoid when:** The entries are system-generated, or the conversation is with an assistant.
- **Consider instead:** `features/activities`, `features/ai-chat`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { CommentAttachmentChip } from "themelia-ui/features/comments"
import "themelia-ui/features/comments.css"
```

## Optional peers

Install these only when importing this family:

```bash
npm install @tiptap/core @tiptap/pm @tiptap/starter-kit
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/action-menu`, `base/avatar`, `base/badge`, `base/buttons`, `base/display`, `base/feedback`, `base/popover`, `base/spinner`, `base/structure`, `base/tooltip`, `base/typography`, `features/mentions`, `features/overlays`, `features/rich-text-editor`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

Kind: callable.

### `CommentThreadOptions`

Kind: interface.

How a thread reads: what folds away and what a reader can do beyond reply and react. Shared by `Comments`, `CommentTimeline` and `CommentItem`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `commentActions` | no | `ContextActionSource<CommentData<TUser, TMeta, TResource>>` | Extra entries for each comment's overflow menu, bound to the comment (`visible`,<br>`disabled` and `onClick` receive it). Listed above pin, edit and delete; `destructive` sorts last. |
| `maxVisibleReplies` | no | `number` | Latest replies shown before earlier ones fold behind "Show N earlier replies". `0` shows all. @default 3 |
| `clampLines` | no | `number` | Lines of a long body shown before "See more" (measured, so short bodies get no control). `0` never clamps. @default 6 |
| `maxVisibleAttachments` | no | `number` | Attachments shown before the rest fold behind "Show N more". `0` shows every file. @default 3 |
| `reactionChoices` | no | `readonly string[]` | The reactions "Add reaction" offers. One reacts immediately; more open a picker. @default ["👍"] |

| `isUploading` | yes | `boolean` |  |
| `addFiles` | yes | `(files: ReadonlyArray<File> \| FileList) => void` |  |
| `removeAttachment` | yes | `(id: string) => void` |  |
| `retryAttachment` | yes | `(id: string) => void` |  |
| `setAttachments` | yes | `(attachments: ReadonlyArray<CommentAttachment>) => void` |  |
| `reset` | yes | `() => void` |  |

### `useComments`

Kind: callable.

```text
(options?: UseCommentsOptions<TUser, TMeta, TResource>) => UseCommentsReturn<TUser, TMeta, TResource>
```

### `UseCommentsOptions`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `onSubmit` | no | `CommentsConfig<TUser, TMeta, TResource>["onSubmit"]` |  |
| `onUpdate` | no | `CommentsConfig<TUser, TMeta, TResource>["onUpdate"]` |  |
| `onDelete` | no | `CommentsConfig<TUser, TMeta, TResource>["onDelete"]` |  |
| `onAfterMutate` | no | `CommentsConfig<TUser, TMeta, TResource>["onAfterMutate"]` |  |
| `onError` | no | `CommentsConfig<TUser, TMeta, TResource>["onError"]` |  |
| `scopeKey` | no | `string` | Invalidates submission-bound helpers when the composer moves to another record. |

### `UseCommentsReturn`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `composerMode` | yes | `ComposerMode<TResource, TUser, TMeta>` |  |
| `isSubmitting` | yes | `boolean` |  |
| `formErrors` | yes | `Record<string, string>` |  |
| `resetKey` | yes | `number` | Bumped to clear the composer, which is otherwise uncontrolled. |
| `startReply` | yes | `(comment: CommentData<TUser, TMeta, TResource>) => void` |  |
| `startEdit` | yes | `(comment: CommentData<TUser, TMeta, TResource>) => void` |  |
| `cancelComposerMode` | yes | `() => void` |  |
| `submit` | yes | `(values: CommentFormValues<TResource>) => Promise<void>` |  |
| `deleteComment` | yes | `(id: string) => Promise<void>` |  |
| `resetComposer` | yes | `() => void` |  |
| `helpers` | yes | `CommentSubmitHelpers` | Passed to `onSubmit` and `onUpdate`. |

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Comments — `/comments`

### A thread

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Comments
  context={{ id: "4417", type: "booking" }}
  comments={comments}
  canModerate
  resources={resources}
  onSubmit={async (values, helpers) => {
    await post(values)
    helpers.reset()
  }}
  onUpdate={update}
  onDelete={remove}
  onReact={react}
  reactionChoices={["👍", "❤️", "🎉", "😄", "👀", "🎯"]}
  commentActions={[
    { id: "copy-link", label: "Copy link", icon: LinkIcon, onClick: copyLink },
  ]}
  attachments={{ onUpload, maxSize: 5_000_000, maxFiles: 3 }}
/>
```

### Submit failure and retry

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Comments
  comments={comments}
  onSubmit={async (values, helpers) => {
    const result = await post(values)
    if (!result.ok) {
      helpers.setErrors({ content: result.message })
      return
    }
    helpers.reset()
  }}
/>
```
